confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sydney prices, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderate confidence; accommodation is less certain because winter (July) rates vary with school holidays and events. Cocktail and wine were sanity-checked against beer (about 2x and 1.2x beer) since direct knowledge is only moderate. No tip is included, as tipping is not customary in Sydney. FX is the RBA 4pm rate for 13 Oct 2026; a 14 Oct figure on the RBA homepage could not be confirmed as the USD rate, so it was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Sydney was estimated directly from general knowledge of Australian east-coast capital pricing (Oceania regional basis).
